instruction: Navigate to the Dota 2 Official Soundtrack page on Steam Store.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated Steam Store, found Dota 2, browsed DLC section (Official Soundtrack at /app/1241930/ and Remixes EP at /app/652720/), added the Soundtrack to cart, and ended on the cart page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Steam Store, search for games, find and navigate to DLC pages, add items to cart, use search bar, scroll pages
metadata.task_rationale: Tests navigation to a specific DLC page the agent visited during the trajectory. Requires finding Dota 2 on Steam and locating its DLC section.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the Dota 2 Official Soundtrack store page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches store.steampowered.com/app/1241930 using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is exactly the state needed to verify navigation.
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly receives the rules dict (via type='rule') and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex patterns list. Parameter handling is correct.
Expected regex pattern 'store\.steampowered\.com/app/1241930' correctly identifies the Dota 2 Official Soundtrack page, confirmed by trajectory data showing /app/1241930/ is the Soundtrack.
Single navigation instruction is fully covered by URL verification — no missing requirements.
Config provides reasonable starting state with Dota 2 homepage and Steam Store open in Chrome tabs.
